remarks:
This well-maintained 3-bedroom ranch on a quiet tree-lined street makes a great first impression w/brick accents, maintenance-free vinyl shake siding, mature landscaping and a newer front entry door w/decorative glass. A covered front porch w/brick columns adds charm, while the concrete driveway w/additional parking pad offers extra convenience.

The renovated kitchen features white cabinetry, granite countertops, stone backsplash, dishwasher and a gas range w/hood vent, plus a bright eat-in area w/built-in shelf. The combined dining and living area spans the rear of the home w/hardwood flooring and a wall of updated windows bringing in natural light. A unique built-in bookcase in the dining area includes a cabinet-style door that conceals storage and provides access to the attic space.

All three bedrooms have hardwood flooring and ceiling fans, w/higher-set windows for privacy and easier furniture placement and a double closet adding storage in the primary bedroom. The full bath features vintage tile flooring in excellent condition paired w/a tub and full tile surround, along w/an updated vanity w/soft-close doors and drawers.

Downstairs, the basement features glass block windows and additional usable space, including two separate rooms that could work well as a home office or hobby room. A separate utility room includes the washer and dryer, which stay w/the home.

The attached garage features an epoxy floor (2016), garage door opener and storage space. The backyard extends the living space outdoors w/a covered concrete patio featuring recessed lighting and drop-down privacy panels, plus a pergola, shed, established perennial gardens and a garden walkway w/room for a vegetable garden too.

A complete tear-off roof (April 2025) includes new architectural shingles, gutters, eaves and ridge vent, backed by a transferable warranty. Other solid mechanicals include drain tile, an UltraSump 4 battery backup sump pump system plus furnace and central air (2011). Enjoy the charm of a well-maintained ranch w/inviting outdoor spaces and convenient access to nearby amenities! 

Showings begin immediately.
